title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. translated_title: 让门控决定：大语言模型中量化条件内存的逐查找精度
translated_abstract: 条件记忆层（如DeepSeek的Engram）将大型哈希n-gram表附加到语言模型上，从DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash中移除该表会损失36.8个PopQA分数。低比特量化会最先丢失长尾事实，而标准补救措施——为频繁访问的行分配更多比特——反而适得其反：按访问频率进行精度提升的效果比随机分配还差。我们将这一问题追溯到缩放每个检索行的门控：一次查找的量化误差由其门控加权，该门控对频繁出现的n-gram较小，对长尾实体的罕见n-gram较大，且可以从1比特编码中计算得出。因此，GateRQ将每一行存储为1比特残差编码的阶梯结构，将第一级保留在GPU内存中以计算门控，仅对门控排名最高的查找读取更深层级。无需重新训练，GateRQ在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上将GPU表内存削减了7.8倍，相比FP8表使vLLM吞吐量提升11%-31%，同时……
tldr: GateRQ利用可从1比特编码计算的门控值（对频繁n-gram小、对长尾n-gram大）来决定各查找所需的量化精度，将每行存储为1比特残差编码阶梯，无需重训即实现GPU表内存7.8倍压缩和vLLM吞吐量11%-31%的提升。
en_tdlr: GateRQ exploits per-lookup gates—computable from a 1-bit code and small for frequent n-grams but large for long-tail ones—to decide which lookups deserve higher precision, storing rows as ladders of 1-bit residual codes to cut GPU table memory by 7.8x and boost vLLM throughput by 11%-31% without retraining.
